description: This PHP source file defines classes related to building and manipulating parse tree structures within the Smarty template engine, specifically for internal template parsing and code generation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Template
classes.description: Represents the parse tree for a Smarty template, managing subtrees and converting the tree into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an empty parse tree for template elements.

methods.name: append_subtree
methods.description: Adds a subtree to the parse tree, merging or appending depending on the subtree content.

methods.name: append_array
methods.description: Appends an array of subtrees to the parse tree.

methods.name: prepend_array
methods.description: Prepends an array of subtrees to the parse tree.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Converts the parse tree into executable Smarty PHP code, processing different modes of subtrees.
